m284.goal: Declare and ship OVMS Agent 1.0.0 as a feature-frozen release-hardening milestone.
m284.help: OVMS_AGENT.HLP reviewed; no command/SETTINGS behavior changed and no HELP edit is required.
m284.architecture: ARCHITECTURE.md reviewed; no release correction required.
m284.pending_vax_exception: BUILD.COM is approximately 60 KB and the GitHub connector only supports whole-file replacement. Make only the hard-coded build banner change from Version 2 to Version 1.0.0 on VAX, commit/push it to m284-v1-release, then independently re-audit GitHub before acceptance.
acceptance_required: Exact final candidate head after BUILD.COM banner commit is present on GitHub.
Output includes All regression tests passed. and Build completed successfully.
Final worktree is clean and core.filemode=false.
promotion_after_acceptance: Open PR and merge exact accepted head to main.
Create permanent m284 and v1.0.0 tags on canonical promoted main.
Retain M283 and M284 milestone branches and prune M282 after tags/ancestry verification.
GitHub connector has no release-create mutation; semantic tags are canonical even if no GitHub Release object can be created in-chat.

standing_rules: Read RULES.md on main and this state at chat start.
GitHub is the default repository editing control plane; ask the user only for VAX compile/link/RMS/live acceptance when needed.
Omit OVMS-AGENT> from agent command lines.
Use GITAUTH for Git network operations.
Canonical acceptance requires All regression tests passed and %X00000001 when a product build is required.
Do not call an untested GitHub candidate or promoted merge VAX-green.
Promotion wording must distinguish a separately VAX-accepted code/content head from a GitHub merge SHA unless the merge SHA itself was run on VAX.
Keep root-level OVMS_AGENT.HLP synchronized with every user-facing command and persistent SETTINGS change in the same milestone/change, including what the feature does and when/why to use it.
Beginning with 1.0.0, semantic releases use vX.Y.Z tags in addition to mNNN milestone tags and follow semantic versioning.
